description: The one generator of derived files (D-069 items 1 and 2, G1): its targets and how scripts/generate reports them.

default.name: registry
default.description: Every split registry owner's aggregate, config/registry/<owner>.json from config/registry/<owner>/ (_owner.json and one <key>.json per parameter; D-095, D-099). It shares config/registry/ with the owners that stay whole (generate and config, which the generator itself reads), so it owns none of the directory's other files. A new owner needs a folder, not a target.

default.name: python-types
default.description: Python TypedDicts of every contract and every registry file; imported by the engine as generated.<module>.

default.name: docs
default.description: The configuration registry and event catalog reference, rendered on demand (printed, or written under --out); never committed.

default.name: status
default.description: The unit status report (owner, contract, battery, intents per unit), derived from the manifests on demand; never committed. The hand-written roadmap step log STATUS.md stays as history (U1, V4).

default.name: census
default.description: The per-area view of the literal census (D-063, D-064 a): scripts/lib/literal-catalogs/<area>.json and scripts/lib/absolute-literals-baseline/<area>.json, joined from each unit's record units/<id>/census.jsonl (scripts/lib/census.py) on demand; never committed, so no pull request carries a file two units write (CENSO-NO-MANIFESTO).

default.name: lane-briefs
default.description: The start brief of every unit of the fluxo-amplo program (D-236, lane 12): docs/process/briefs/fluxo-amplo/<id>.md, one per unit of the plan's program.v1 block (title, owner, wave, dependencies, done criteria as a checklist). Committed, so a missing or stale brief fails --check; a lane starts from its brief.

default.name: lane-digest
default.description: The lane rules digest (VAZÃO F78): docs/process/lane-digest.md, the ```digest block of the Rules digest section of docs/process/lane.md, at most 1.5 KB. scripts/lane brief carries it in place of the delivery contract; committed, so a stale digest fails --check.

generate.targets.description: Every target of scripts/generate, one entry per unique name; the renderer is scripts/lib/generate_<name>.py. sources are globs from the repository root; output is the directory (or file) the target owns; committed targets are checked by the generated drift stage; a target that is not enabled is skipped and listed, and requires names a glob that must match before the target can be enabled.
generate.targets.x-source: D-069 items 1 and 2; plan v3.1 delta §2 G1

generate.lane_digest_max_bytes.description: The most bytes docs/process/lane-digest.md may hold (VAZÃO F78: 1.5 KB); scripts/generate lane-digest refuses a longer Rules digest, and the lane brief stays under twice it.

generate.merge_driver_name.description: The git merge driver that settles a conflict in a committed generated file by regenerating it from the merged sources (scripts/merge-regenerate). .gitattributes names it for each such file (`<path> merge=<name>`); scripts/cloud/setup.sh registers it in the checkout's git config.

generate.merge_inner_env.description: The variable the merge driver sets on the nested `git merge-tree` it runs to rebuild the merged sources, so the nested call of the driver does a plain 3-way merge instead of recursing.
